title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent, a built-in Copilot agent for each Teams channel
summary: Hold: the retention command creates a policy but does not configure the rule that actually retains content. The briefing also turns the roadmap's Worldwide listing into an unsupported exclusion of other clouds. Most feature, licensing and default-state statements are supported, and the disagreements between Microsoft pages are disclosed.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies is the route to policies used for Channel Agent retention.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft Purview portal, navigate to Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention Policies and create a retention policy with the following policy location: - Teams chats for interactions with a channel agent
claims.fix: The route stops on the policy list. For a new static policy, use 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy > Teams chats'. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies, which documents these remaining steps.

claims.claim: New-RetentionCompliancePolicy -Name <String> -TeamsChatLocation <MultiValuedProperty> is the automation that implements retention of Channel Agent interactions.
claims.quote: Policies are not valid until a rule is added (for retention policies) or a label is added (for retention label policies).
claims.fix: Replace controls[4].api.call with 'New-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy <PolicyIdParameter> -RetentionDuration <days-or-Unlimited> -RetentionComplianceAction <Keep-or-KeepAndDelete>' and api.docs with https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-retentioncompliancerule. Replace the note with 'Security & Compliance PowerShell. Apply the rule to an existing policy with the Teams chats location.' The existing command creates the policy and selects its users, but does not set a retention action or duration.

claims.claim: A retention policy needs a New-RetentionComplianceRule rule before it takes effect.
claims.quote: Creating a new policy also requires use of the New-RetentionComplianceRule cmdlet. ... Policies are not valid until a rule is added (for retention policies)
